title: SMD_A&CM_RFQ #518113 - Elevator Rehabilitation and Maintenance for Haber Houses, Coney Island Site 8 and ODwyer Gardens
agency_path: City of New York > Housing Authority
description_text:
The Work under this Contract (RFQ No. 518113  Elevator Package) consists of the rehabilitation, modernization, maintenance, and service of six (6) elevators at Haber Houses, thirteen (13) elevators at O'Dwyer Gardens, and two (2) elevators at Coney Island I Site 8. The Contractor shall provide all labor, materials, equipment, supervision, and incidental services necessary to complete the Work in accordance with the Contract Documents.

The scope includes, but is not limited to, the removal and replacement of existing elevator systems and the furnishing and installation of new elevator equipment, including machines, controls, hoistway components, car enclosures, doors, communication systems, safety devices, and associated electrical components. The Work also includes testing, inspection, commissioning, training, and coordination with NYCHA and other trades, including separate electrical and abatement packages.

The Work shall be performed in phased construction to maintain building operations, with coordination requirements intended to minimize service interruptions and impacts to residents. The Contractor shall comply with all scheduling, outage duration, and performance requirements established in the Contract Documents.

In addition to construction and modernization activities (Part A), the Contractor shall enter into a separate Maintenance and Service Agreement (Part B) to provide ongoing elevator maintenance and support services during and following the completion of modernization.
